data.task_title: Create Artemis self-demo with Chart.js visualization

features.title: Chart.js Visualization Integration
features.description: Integrate Chart.js to create visualizations for pipeline metrics, cost tracking, and success rates.
acceptance_criteria: Pipeline metrics are visualized using Chart.js.
Cost tracking is displayed with appropriate charts.
Success rates are shown using Chart.js visualizations.

features.title: Real-Time Dashboard
features.description: Develop a real-time dashboard with Chart.js graphs for various metrics.
acceptance_criteria: LLM cost over time is shown as a line chart.
Stage completion rates are displayed as a bar chart.
Success rate trends are visualized as an area chart.

features.title: Code Quality Metrics
features.description: Show code quality metrics like TDD compliance and SOLID principles using a radar chart.
acceptance_criteria: A radar chart displays TDD compliance.
SOLID principles are visualized in the radar chart.
The chart is accurate and informative.

features.title: HTML Presentation Creation
features.description: Develop a standalone HTML file for the Artemis demo with embedded CSS, JavaScript, and Chart.js.
acceptance_criteria: The HTML file is standalone with no external dependencies.
CSS and JavaScript are embedded within the HTML file.
Chart.js is included for data visualization.

features.title: Pipeline Visualization
features.description: Create an 8-stage pipeline visualization using Chart.js.
acceptance_criteria: The pipeline is represented in 8 stages.
Each stage is clearly visualized using Chart.js.
The visualization is accurate and informative.

features.title: Results Display
features.description: Present real metrics from recent runs using actual data.
acceptance_criteria: Real metrics are displayed in the presentation.
Data is accurate and up-to-date.
Metrics are presented in a clear and understandable format.

features.title: Supervisor Integration Visualization
features.description: Display supervisor integration across stages using a pie chart.
acceptance_criteria: A pie chart represents supervisor integration.
The chart accurately reflects integration data.
The visualization is clear and easy to understand.

features.title: Interactive Elements and Animations
features.description: Enhance the presentation with Chart.js animations and interactive elements.
acceptance_criteria: Chart.js animations are implemented for visual appeal.
Interactive elements are included for user engagement.
Animations and interactions are smooth and responsive.

features.title: Auto-Advance and Navigation Controls
features.description: Enable slides to auto-advance with user navigation controls.
acceptance_criteria: Slides auto-advance after a set duration.
Users can manually navigate between slides.
Navigation controls are intuitive and responsive.

features.title: Professional Design and Transitions
features.description: Implement a professional gradient background and smooth slide transitions.
acceptance_criteria: A gradient background is applied to the presentation.
Slide transitions are smooth and professional.
Visual elements are aesthetically pleasing.
